summary: Budgets are justified as cost and failure-containment controls, provided they account for task value and do not reward superficially cheap but incomplete work.

points.text: Enforce limits outside the model process; a prompt that asks an agent to stop spending is not a reliable financial control.
Track cost per accepted outcome, retry rate, review burden and failure class alongside tokens so teams do not optimize the denominator alone.
Reserve capacity for validation and safe shutdown. Exhausting the budget immediately after generation can leave no allowance to test, summarize or hand off state.
